name: allinonex
description: All in One dual-platform plugin monorepo for Figma and MasterGo

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix figma && npm ci --prefix mastergo
scripts.build: npm run sync:ui && npm --prefix figma run build && npm --prefix mastergo run build
scripts.verify: npm run sync:ui && npm run verify:figma && npm run verify:mastergo && npm run check:parity && npm run check:smart-fill && npm run check:fill-generators && npm run check:chinese-names && npm run check:localization && npm run check:window-bookmarks && npm run check:layer-workflows && npm run check:ai-contracts && npm run check:component-families
